messages:
maria: Quick review of streaming playground mocks. Key frictions: ambiguous Stop/Resume wording, token counter is too prominent during streaming, prompt library peek scrolls the stream offscreen. figma: https://figma.com/file/playground-stream-ux
jamie: Agreed. Which 2 are highest priority for beta?
maria: 1) Make stop vs resume semantics explicit + add undo pattern. 2) Move token counter out of message rail (low-density by default).
lee: Dev note: we currently have a single interrupt action. I can split into Stop (hard cancel) and Resume/Resumeable Pause. Need final copy and small state transitions. Also recommend debouncing token updates to 1s to avoid jank.
aria: A11y: stream should be aria-live="polite". Token counter must not be a live region. If Stop discards content, announce toast that receives focus with Undo.
maria: Copy option: short labels "Stop" and "Pause" with tooltips explaining destructiveness. Keep labels concise.
jamie: Default token counter inline under prompt; add user setting for floating pill. Track toggle usage in analytics.
lee: I'll implement toggle + debounce + undo toast. Will default to split panel for desktop, overlay on mobile for prompt library.
ci-bot: branch 'playground/stream-clarity' created. CI passed.
maria: I'll update Figma with toast + tooltips and add a11y checklist. Assign: @lee implement, @aria run a11y tests, @jamie add metrics.
jamie: On it. ETA next week. :thumbsup:
